name: Project Gutenberg
legal: Livres du domaine public aux États-Unis, diffusés gratuitement par Project Gutenberg. Tous les livres en français pour l'instant ; le filtre « domaine public en France » existe et peut être activé (france_public_domain).
notes: Gutenberg asks tools to use the offline catalogues instead of crawling (https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/offline_catalogs.html). Its OPDS search is disallowed by robots.txt, so it is not used. The CSV is refreshed weekly upstream; we harvest weekly. Its XML OPDS is announced to sunset in 2027: if an OPDS 2 feed becomes public, switch to kind opds2. Owner's decision 2026-10-31: full French catalogue for now, france_public_domain off (to be discussed).
